# JFC / IDE startup instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [spec governance](../agent-rules/SPEC-GOVERNANCE.md), [canonical Notion Skill](https://app.notion.com/p/4021642b67f381179e2ff62b1c2f7cc8), [STABLE product baseline](https://app.notion.com/p/4011642b67f38177b1c9cc5b00dcf734), latest owner prompts and active file reservations BEFORE implementing.

Do not infer specs from AI suggestions, code reviews, historical comments or IDE completions. For friendly-123, E1–E6 and owner-approved S1 hotfixes only: reproduce real defect, minimal reversible change, focused acceptance, independent review, STOP once fixed. No data purge/migration, new features, cosmetic redesign, unapproved providers/domains or shell changes. If unable to fetch Notion, state the context gap. Do not edit agent files reserved to other agents (including CLAUDE.md).
